summary.text: Tiffany Cabán represents a western Queens Council district that includes Astoria, Jackson Heights, East Elmhurst and LaGuardia Airport.
Her Council biography says she was a public defender before joining the Council and co-chairs the Council's LGBTQIA+ Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Cabán was born in Richmond Hill, Queens, to Puerto Rican parents, according to her Council biography.

She attended P.S. 62, J.H.S. 210 and St. Francis Preparatory High School, earned a bachelor's degree in crime, law and justice from Pennsylvania State University, and received a J.D. from New York Law School.
As a public defender at New York County Defender Services and the Legal Aid Society she represented over a thousand clients in cases ranging from turnstile jumping to homicide.
On the Council she has introduced and passed legislation supporting survivors of gender-based violence, protecting abortion care and moving homeless New Yorkers to permanent homes.
She is a leader in Local Progress and lives in Astoria.
